entries.title: Astral Prism skip chain, Star Tornado field, and rare 100% orb rolls
entries.summary: Astral Prism's dodge package was expanded so Orbit Step can perform a true multi-skip counter, Star Tornado now lingers as a pulling damage-over-time particle tornado, and ordinary percent orb rolls gained a tiny chance to land an exact 100% stat line.
entries.actionSubtitle: Astral combat and orb roll polish
details: Astral Orbit Step now starts a delayed multi-skip sequence instead of only doing an instant single reposition: the player blinks around the attacker up to 6 times with short gaps between skips, then finishes with a counter strike and astral particle burst.
Fixed the Astral defensive proc order so a failed Starforce roll no longer blocks Orbit Step from trying on the same incoming hit, making the multi-skip move much easier to actually see in combat.
Astral Star Tornado now creates an active tornado field for several seconds instead of only doing one instant AoE burst.
Enemies inside Star Tornado are pulled inward, spun around the funnel, lightly lifted, and damaged over time while the particle tornado remains active.
Star Tornado visuals now keep ticking while active, using astral purple/cyan spark, glow, witch-magic, and falling star-style particles before ending in a burst.
All ordinary percent orb stat rolls now have a tiny jackpot chance to roll an exact 100% line. Existing socket handling preserves 100 as a true 100% value instead of collapsing it to 1%.

entries.title: HyperText Prefix/Suffix Width and CustomNPC Wrapping Fix
entries.summary: A new HexFontRenderer pass fixed the long-running prefix and suffix smushing issue caused by HyperText display names, while also restoring the CustomNPC HyperText text-area and wrapping support.
details: Fixed the player prefix/suffix spacing issue where Essentials/GroupManager display names could look crushed or overlapped when HyperText was rendered through the custom HexFontRenderer.
Updated HexFontRenderer width handling so HyperText names measure closer to how they actually render, especially with bold styled text and colored prefixes or suffixes.
Improved display-name compatibility for EssentialsChat-style formats such as '<{DISPLAYNAME}> {MESSAGE}', allowing HyperText inside the name without breaking chat spacing.
Restored the CustomNPC HyperText pass for dialog text, text areas, and wrapping behavior so longer custom text no longer wraps incorrectly in NPC GUI screens.
Removed the fragile inner TextAreaState dependency from the CustomNPC HyperText hook path, preventing the previous missing-class crash when opening CustomNPC dialog management screens.
Bundled the CustomNPC wrapping/text-area fix and the prefix/suffix width fix together as a source patch so the text rendering chain is safer and more consistent.

entries.title: Dream Gem Effects Complete + Legacy Totem DBC Fix
entries.summary: The Dream Gem/Orb effect chain has been completed with seven passive effects, animated Dream HUD support, Reverie status-style icons, Nightmare Bloom visuals, and a DBC-safe Legacy Totem fix that prevents false activations from low vanilla health.
details: Finished the full Dream Gem/Orb passive effect set: Dream Echo, Lucid Recovery, Dream Slip, False Awakening, Dream Fracture, Reverie Chain, and Nightmare Bloom.
Dream Echo can repeat a hit shortly after impact with a weaker dream echo strike and improved glow, enchant, portal, shimmer, and afterimage-style particles.
Lucid Recovery now checks DBC Body thresholds, restores Body/Ki/Stamina during its recovery window, uses a cooldown, and hides or resumes its HUD properly when the Dream source is swapped.
Dream Slip now catches damage through safer DBC-aware attack/hurt handling, reduces incoming damage, plays UI dodge-style feedback, and uses dream shimmer particles.
False Awakening adds a weaker dream-themed near-death save with a long cooldown, small recovery, brief protection, and modern dream/totem-style particles.
Dream Fracture now applies a soft utility debuff that makes targets deal less damage and take more damage, using the same all-damage-path handling proven by the Fracture Brew test item.
Reverie Chain adds a short lucid rhythm window where the next hit can trigger a random bonus such as cooldown refund, Ki refund, Stamina refund, Body refund, bonus hit, or haze mark.
Reverie Chain received custom status-style icons and now renders its active bonus near the JRM/DBC status-effect icon area instead of only using the Dream cooldown shelf.

Nightmare Bloom now plants a dream seed that swirls through and around the target, loops back several times, then blooms into a small dream explosion with soft weaken effects and a Body refund for the Dream holder.
Dream HUD support was expanded with animated dream bars, Dream Gem icon usage, source-aware clearing/resuming, and cooldown rows for the completed passive chain.
Fixed the Legacy Totem DBC interaction so it no longer pops every hit just because vanilla health is low while DBC Body is still alive.
For DBC players, Legacy Totem activation is now gated around true lethal danger instead of vanilla-health-only damage checks.

entries.title: Orb Effects, Modern Particles, Slash Scaling, and Server Fixes
entries.summary: The latest HexColorText passes expanded modern particle support, improved Void Relic effects, lowered cooldown reduction caps for stacking balance, fixed several HUD/icon issues, and improved server-side slash activation for custom weapons.
details: <rune><grad #B994FF #63F7FF #FFFFFF #9B6CFF scroll=0.18>Modern particle support was expanded with a full particle catalog, JSON frame mapping, aliases, presets, and script APIs for effects like dragon_breath, sculk_charge, sonic_boom, totem_of_undying, sweep_attack, and more.</grad></rune>

<rune><grad #7A35FF #B994FF #63F7FF #FFFFFF scroll=0.20>Void Rend now uses modern and classic particle layers, applies a chance-based DoT, and can trigger upgraded Void-style visuals through Void Relic effects.</grad></rune>

<rune><grad #3A0A66 #7A35FF #D6B3FF #FFFFFF scroll=0.16>Void Relic gained rare Void Explosion support, using modern particles and multiple explosion hits where higher hit counts reduce individual hit damage.</grad></rune>

<rune><grad #63F7FF #9B6CFF #FFFFFF #76FFB8 scroll=0.18>Perfect Core and Fractured threshold messages were cleaned up so they trigger on threshold changes instead of every Body increment or decrement, now showing actual Body or HP values with brighter HyperText styling.</grad></rune>

<rune><grad #FFE27A #FFFFFF #76FFB8 #63F7FF scroll=0.20>Cooldown reduction caps were reduced again for stacking balance: Crystalline Ocean and most next-gen gems now cap much lower, while Dream Gem remains higher but still nerfed.</grad></rune>

<rune><grad #FFFFFF #9B6CFF #63F7FF #FFFFFF scroll=0.17>Haki Slash, Multi Slash, and Reaping Wave now scale from a DBC stat formula focused mostly on Dexterity, with Strength and WillPower contributing as secondary stats.</grad></rune>

<rune><grad #B994FF #FFFFFF #63F7FF #9B6CFF scroll=0.18>The slash input handler now supports raw right-click hold as a fallback, helping custom weapons that qualify for slash effects but do not properly enter vanilla blocking state on servers.</grad></rune>

<rune><grad #76FFB8 #FFFFFF #B994FF #63F7FF scroll=0.16>HexMaster GUI packet initialization was improved for dedicated servers, addressing cases where /hexmaster said it was opening the GUI but nothing appeared.</grad></rune>

<rune><grad #FFD966 #FFFFFF #76FFB8 #63F7FF scroll=0.18>Sign FPS rendering now keeps targeted signs vanilla by default, making SignShop setup safer while preserving cached sign rendering for large sign walls.</grad></rune>

entries.title: Next-Gen Orb Balance, DBC Body Regen, and Totem Death Bypass Fix
entries.summary: Next-gen orb cooldown reduction was brought down with new per-orb caps, pulsed DBC Body regeneration was added, and the Totem of Undying now uses a stronger JRMCore revive-bypass flow so it can save players before Otherworld death handling takes over.
details: Next-gen orb cooldown reduction was reduced again and now clamps to safer per-orb caps instead of letting old or high rolls keep oversized cooldown values.
Dream Gem keeps the highest cooldown-reduction identity at up to 64%, Crystalline Ocean Gem now caps at 45%, and the rest of the next-gen orb family is capped at 60% or lower.

Next-gen orbs gained a pulsed DBC Body regeneration effect. Instead of constantly healing every tick, the effect briefly restores Body, stops, waits a few seconds, then starts another small regen pulse.

The Totem of Undying now catches lethal damage earlier and forces a stronger JRMCore alive-state guard so it can prevent DBC/JRMCore death handling from immediately sending the player to Otherworld after the totem is consumed.

The totem revive path now refreshes vanilla health, restores DBC Body above zero, clears dangerous effects, resets death/damaged flags, and keeps the player alive for a short guard window after activation.

entries.title: Haki Weapon Texture Pass: Vanilla, DBC, CustomNPC+, Chocolate Quest, Plugin, and More
entries.summary: The Haki weapon coating system was expanded across vanilla and several major mod weapon sets, including CustomNPC+, Dragon Block C, Chocolate Quest, MrCrayfish Furniture, and ThePlugin. Static and animated weapon textures now have Armament, Hardening, Ryuo, and Conqueror variants where supported.
details: Vanilla item Haki rendering was fixed first: active Haki now uses stitched item-atlas icons for inventory, first-person, and third-person views instead of reverting to vanilla textures or white-square fallback renders when Slash or Multi Slash fires.

CustomNPC+ received Haki textures for the confirmed melee weapon set, including swords, broadswords, scythes, daggers, spears, tridents, halberds, glaives, battle axes, maces, warhammers, claws, katanas, rapiers, sabers, kukris, and other generic attack weapons.

Dragon Block C received a normal item-icon Haki pass for its sword, axe, spear, club, hammer, blade, and handle items, plus an extended model-texture pass for special rendered weapons like Katana, Brave Sword, Z Sword, Dimension Sword, Evil Spear, and Power Pole.

Chocolate Quest received Haki textures for real ItemCQBlade-style melee weapons, including swords, big swords, daggers, spears, hook sword, and the Bull battle axe, while guns, staves, shields, armor, and utility items were skipped to avoid accidental coating.

The mixed utility-mod scan only found one true generic-attack weapon target: the MrCrayfish Furniture knife. It now has all four Haki texture modes while non-weapon blocks, tools, render libraries, and chest upgrades were left untouched.

ThePlugin received the largest Haki expansion: hundreds of registered melee/generic-attack Plugin weapons were added to the Haki texture bank, including preserved .mcmeta animation files for animated weapon textures.
Each supported weapon family now has four Haki modes: Armament, Hardening, Ryuo, and Conqueror. These modes are intended to match the existing weapon Haki state rather than replacing item behavior.
The Haki renderer keeps using the stitched-atlas path and mod-aware held transforms so coated weapons should keep their normal inventory, first-person, and third-person presentation while active.
Ranged weapons, spell items, shields, armor, vanity items, render-only entity weapons, and utility tools were intentionally skipped unless they were confirmed as true melee or generic-attack items.

entries.title: Hit Skill Script Cleanup: Counters, Time Stop, and Knockback Fixes
entries.summary: The Hit-style moveset script received another cleanup pass focused on counter behavior, Time Stop escape handling, safer cooldown display logic, and more reliable knockback after frozen-time damage resolves.
details: Cleaned up several script bugs from the large Hit moveset file, including duplicate logic, mismatched helper names, unsafe timer references, and places where old debug or fallback paths could conflict with newer skill behavior.
Flash Fist Crush was adjusted so the normal Lv1–5 counter path properly reflects damage back onto the attacker instead of only arming visuals or failing to credit the reflected hit.
Tremor Pulse Lv1–5 was adjusted so its normal counter path also reflects the attacker correctly while keeping Over Heaven / Lv6 behavior separate as the healing-style variant.
Counter moves now include knockback on successful reflected hits, making Flash Fist Crush and Tremor Pulse feel more like real counterattacks instead of only delayed damage pops.
Time Stop escape handling was reviewed so escaped players can break free, bank damage against the caster during the escape window, and then refreeze correctly if time has not fully resumed.
Time Stop end handling was improved so stored frozen-time damage, escape-window damage, overlays, countdowns, and cleanup paths resolve more safely when time resumes.
Frozen-time knockback was made more reliable after final stored damage is applied, including cases where the stored damage is high enough to nearly kill or fully defeat the target.
The cooldown HUD behavior was left mostly intact because the cooldown timer setup was already intentionally structured that way.

entries.title: Legacy Items, Totem, Slash Cooldowns, and Texture Fixes
entries.summary: A new legacy item cleanup pass restored missing food textures, fixed the Piss Bucket visuals, added the Totem of Undying, separated normal Slash and Multi Slash cooldowns, increased slash range, and cleaned up several orb and food behavior issues.
details: Missing legacy item textures were re-imported from the old cursed source so the broken magenta-black placeholder icons should now display correctly.
The Piss Bucket now uses its proper legacy bucket texture and keeps the custom yellow piss-fluid still/flowing textures instead of looking like a normal water bucket.
The Totem of Undying was added as a HexColor Text item and moved into the main HexColor Text creative tab instead of the Legacy Useless tab.
The Totem of Undying can cancel one fatal hit, consume itself, restore health, clear harmful potion effects, and attempt to restore DBC Body.
Normal Slash and Multi Slash now use separate cooldowns, so the regular slash and Sneak + Right Click multi-combo no longer lock each other out.
Slash range was increased for both normal Slash and Multi Slash so the visual waves have a better chance to connect with targets.
Multi Slash HUD labeling was separated from the regular slash label, showing Multi Slash or Multi Reaping when the combo skill is on cooldown.
Dorite Taco Cool Ranch duration was increased to 2 minutes so the food effect lasts long enough to feel useful without returning to old overpowered legacy values.
The Heart item is now an instant right-click consume item instead of behaving like a normal slow-eating food.
Orb effect rolls that land exactly on 100% now display as 100% instead of being shifted down or shown incorrectly.

entries.title: GUI Fix: DBC screens now safer with HyperText present
entries.summary: A safety pass was added for DBC/JRMCore GUI screens so HyperText already present in chat, overlays, item names, or tooltips should no longer explode the extended inventory or other JinRyuu screens.
details: DBC/JRMCore GUI screens now use a safer HexFontRenderer path instead of letting animated HyperText effects run directly through JinRyuu layout and trim-width math.
HyperText already visible in chat or HUD overlays should continue rendering normally while DBC screens are open.
Actual DBC/JRMCore GUI text is sanitized by stripping custom HyperText tags and animated effects while preserving normal vanilla formatting codes like §a, §l, and §r.
This should prevent extended inventory and related DBC GUI screens from exploding when styled item names, tooltips, chat messages, or overlays are present.
No dev_assets update was needed for this fix because it was code-only.
Vanity-to-armor support was reviewed: the safer future path is to create armor-wrapper versions of vanity items in our mod instead of directly mutating DBC/JRMCore vanity items.

entries.title: Visual Dev: Haki slash fixes, Black Coffin / Dragon Fist refresh, HUD polish, and new gem rolls
entries.summary: The 1.21.11 asset refresh pass has been folded into the current mod source with Black Coffin visuals, Dragon Fist effects, cooldown HUD upgrades, new animated gems, and several Haki slash fixes. The latest pass also fixes the slash/blocking jitter and makes slash waves follow the player's look pitch instead of staying mostly flat.
details: Black Coffin received a visual refresh using sculk-style charge, soul, forcefield, shriek, flash, and discharge-style overlays. The goal was to make the move feel darker and more modern without changing its core damage behavior.

Dragon Fist received new visual additions using sonic-boom rings, gust trails, small-gust overlays, flash bursts, and impact-style explosion overlays. This makes the rush and hit moments read stronger in combat.

Cooldown HUDs were refreshed with modern boss-bar style textures for Black Coffin, Dragon Fist, and Haki Slash / Reaping Wave. These are lightweight HUD textures and should not bring back the old sign/shop FPS problem.
The correct dev_assets folder was updated with the new Black Coffin, Dragon Fist, HUD, and gem textures so the dev environment can render the new visuals correctly.
New animated gems were added to the mod and included in the gem/orb drop pool. Their tooltip preview was updated to show the new random stat roll behavior.

New gem stat rolls now use random DBC .Multi stats with values from -5% up to +15%. Rolls can include one stat, multiple stats, or rarely all five main stats. Effects are still left for a future design pass.
Haki slash waves were updated to follow the player's full look direction using yaw and pitch, so slashes can now travel upward, downward, or diagonally based on where the player is aiming.

The Haki slash blocking jitter was fixed by removing the forced swing call from the slash fire path and adding a small release buffer / cooldown message throttle. Blocking should no longer spaz out when the slash key logic is involved.
Earlier Haki slash compile issues were cleaned up too, including the misplaced @Override in EntityHakiSlashWave and missing helper-method calls in WeaponHakiSlashController.

entries.title: HexHub FPS + Style Rendering Fixed
entries.summary: <pulse><rbw>HexHub performance was stabilized while restoring styled JSON entries, animated tag pills, and the Nyan strip.</rbw></pulse>
details: <rune><grad #63F7FF #A98BFF #FF4FD8 #FFE27A>HexHub FPS drops were fixed by keeping the lighter render path for plain text and routing styled JSON text back through HexFontRenderer.</grad></rune>
<pulse><grad #76FFB8 #FFFFFF #63F7FF>The boring flat tag look was corrected, so tagStyle and tagBackgroundStyle entries can show properly again.</grad></pulse>
<grad #FFE27A #FF9B2F #FF4FD8>The Nyan strip remains unchanged, and the item-info/socket icon cache fix is still included.</grad>
<rbw>Result: smoother HexHub performance without losing the flashy styled feed look.</rbw>

entries.title: Weapon Dev: Phoenix stable, Rose Scythe sweep work, and blade model cleanup
entries.summary: Phoenix Nodachi is in a much better in-hand state, the Hyper Energy Scythe has progressed into a staged rose/magenta weapon with sweep/AoE experiments, and the oversized purple-orange blade line is being rebuilt with cleaner Blockbench/dev-asset workflow. Current focus is now model polish, item registration, and keeping heavy Blockbench files out of the runtime jar.
details: Cursed Blade status: the current in-game version is acceptable for now. Deep Cursed Blade work can stay paused while newer weapon work focuses on Phoenix Nodachi, Hyper Energy Scythe, and the purple-orange Cosmic Ember Blade direction.

Phoenix Nodachi status: the weapon reached a much better in-hand state after placement, icon, guard, connection, and cutting-edge direction fixes. Future Phoenix work should be small positioning or texture polish instead of full rewrites.

Phoenix placement lesson: Dragon Block C katana-style rendering helped confirm that the handle and blade need a clean shared local axis, with the handle passing through the hand pivot rather than floating from the shoulder or hilt root.

Hyper Energy Scythe status: the scythe line moved into a 4-stage rose/magenta evolution concept. Stage-based damage, visual scale, sweep cooldown, AoE range, AoE damage, and double-slash chance were tested.

Scythe sweep work: the sweep effect evolved from small rose particles into a larger custom rose/flat crescent slash. Several placement passes tested 1.9-style sweep, Getsuga-like flat crescent behavior, crosshair anchoring, and stage-based cooldowns.

Scythe combat tuning: the current staged sweep test uses different cooldowns and AoE values per stage, with a small double-slash chance. The final stage remains intended to be the strongest form and should keep the highest damage identity.

Scythe visual note: the inventory sprites remain the strongest scythe asset and should be preserved as the target identity: dark purple-black metal, rose/magenta energy, glowing head core, crystal shards, and crescent energy blade.

Scythe model status: held-model work is still not final. The rough prism/sprite/Blockbench attempts helped test direction, but the final scythe still needs a proper model pass that matches the strong inventory sprite silhouette.

DBC Fn key idea: future custom weapon skills can piggyback DBC's existing Fn key as a modifier. For example, if the custom skill key is B, the real trigger can become DBC Fn + B, while still letting DBC own its normal key handling.

Cosmic Ember Blade direction: a new oversized purple-orange blade concept was explored as a zanpakuto-like great blade with dark cosmic purple body, ember-orange cutting edge, wrapped handle, and winged/angelic guard details.

Cosmic Ember Blade model status: multiple Blockbench test files were created, but the current issue is that the hilt still reads too much like a starburst instead of real wings, and the blade tip needs to be centered and cleaned up.

Winged hilt target: the guard should read as angel wings, with feather-like stepped voxel layers sweeping outward and slightly upward/downward. It should not look like a generic star, cross, or spike cluster.
Blade tip target: the tip needs to be centered on the blade axis and taper naturally into the silhouette, instead of looking like an offset cap or stacked block cluster.

Blockbench workflow update: .bbmodel files, model references, and experimental model sources should live under dev_assets/blockbench instead of src/main/resources so they stay editable without being packed into the runtime jar.

Jar-size cleanup: moving Blockbench models out of runtime resources is the correct approach. Only actual in-game textures, lang files, sounds, and runtime assets should remain under src/main/resources.

Current source organization: a runtime-clean source zip was made with model files moved out of src/main/resources, plus a dev-assets pack containing Blockbench files for editing outside the built mod jar.

Important item note: adding .bbmodel files or dev assets does not automatically add new weapons to the mod. If the new weapons do not show in HexColorText, the next source task is item registration, creative tab entries, icon paths, names, and renderer hookup.

Future model patch rule: continue using the latest uploaded source as baseline, keep Java 6 compatibility, avoid wildcard imports, and do not bundle runtime-only mod jars or dev-only Blockbench files into the final mod jar.

entries.title: A new Useless Legacy Cleanup
entries.summary: Legacy Useless blocks and items received a major cleanup pass with better textures, restored behavior, a dedicated creative tab, and a renderer fix.
entries.actionSubtitle: Texture, behavior, tab, and renderer cleanup
details: Added a new Legacy Useless creative tab for the old Useless port items.
Moved the legacy Useless blocks and items out of Hex Items to reduce clutter.
Cleaned duplicate legacy entries while keeping old registered blocks safe for existing worlds.
Fixed pink, magenta, gray, black-white, grape, and several wood/log texture mappings.
Restored gray and black-white block behavior, including burnable, axe-mineable, craftable, drop, and pass-through behavior where intended.
Glow Ice, Packed Glow Ice, and Glow Glass were adjusted closer to their intended transparent glowing look.
Cursed Diamond Block Food is edible again, uses a 3D-style block item render, and has a toned-down Speed effect.
Restored the Damage Indicators-safe HexFontRenderer hybrid fix after the block cleanup drifted from the working renderer class.
Brightened the Hex Items creative tab gradient so it reads better on the inventory background.

entries.title: HyperText Chat Wrapping Stabilized
entries.summary: The HyperText chat and CustomNPC wrapping work is now mostly stabilized, including the raw chat overflow fix and better styled-line carry across wrapped text.
entries.actionSubtitle: Raw chat no longer stack-overflows, and long styled messages now preserve gradients, pulse, wave, rainbow, and scroll effects much more reliably.
details: Fixed the raw chat StackOverflow issue caused by the older wrapping path.
Improved wrapped HyperText rendering so styled blocks survive across multiple visual lines.
Pink wave text, pulse gradients, rainbow lines, and scrolling gradients now render correctly after wrapping.
Added safer handling for split or fragmented tags so raw tag pieces are much less likely to appear in chat.
Large styled messages now work best when normal spaces are placed between major styled sections.

entries.title: NEI Tooltip Marker Fixed
entries.summary: Fixed the hidden NEI tooltip marker that caused styled HexText item names to show a tiny smushed tail.
details: Fixed the long-standing smushed tail artifact on styled item tooltip names.
The issue was caused by NEI / CodeChicken adding a hidden §h tooltip marker to the first tooltip line.
HexText item names were rendering that hidden marker as a tiny visible tail at the end of the name.
The renderer now strips the hidden §h marker safely without breaking stack counts.
Trailing §r cleanup is still useful for lang entries, but §h was the real cause of the NEI hover tooltip artifact.
Result: styled item names, orb names, and hover tooltips now render cleanly with no extra smushed character at the end.

entries.title: HexText CustomNPC Support Improved
entries.summary: CustomNPC dialog text, options, macros, and wrapped HyperText messages now behave much more cleanly.
details: Improved HexText wrapping for long chat messages, rank-up messages, quest-complete text, and friendship progress output.
Fixed nested style wrapping so combinations like shadow, pulse, gradient, wave, and macro presets carry across wrapped lines more safely.
Improved CustomNPC compatibility for dialog bodies, dialog options, and GUI label text using the HexText renderer bridge.
Confirmed that amp macros like &xblackgBlackflame Thread&/xblackg can work in CustomNPC dialog choices after the macro bridge fixes.
Added broader macro support so future renderer-registered macros can be repaired more reliably when CustomNPC converts amp codes.
Important syntax reminder: use <grad #ff3c00 #ffb000>Text</grad>, not the old <grad=#ff3c00:#ffb000>Text</grad> format.
Added more macro/shortcut styles to have more variety.

entries.title: God Form Masters polish update
entries.summary: Janne and Dahke now use the improved portrait refresh flow, and Dahke sparring setup is now in progress.
entries.details:
Updated Janneftw2 (GodFormQuest) and Dahke(Godform) with the Whis-style portrait refresh method. Their master portraits now refresh on first unlock and repeat accepted interactions, helping cross-dimension master cards keep saved portraits instead of falling back to initials.

Dahke sparring support is also being set up. The spawner flow is currently in progress and will follow the newer master/rank-aware structure used for God Form training.
entries.actionSubtitle: Janne/Dahke portrait cache fixes + Dahke sparring setup progress

entries.title: God Form Revamp Progress
entries.summary: The God Form revamp is now 25% finished.
details: The first major phase of the God Form revamp is underway.
Current progress is around 25%, with early systems, dialogue flow, and mentor/rank-up structure being worked into place.
More updates will follow as additional God Form training, progression, rewards, and polish are completed.

entries.title: God Form Rank-Up Setup + SSJ4 Fur Color
entries.summary: Finished the first God Form rank-up setup, cleaned up HexMaster command/API behavior, and added SSJ4 fur color support across the server and mod side.
details: Finished the first God Form rank-up flow setup for Janneftw2 (GodFormQuest), including rank-up-ready dialog handling, repeat-safe quest completion checks, and persistent post-rank interaction behavior.
Updated HexMaster command/API behavior to reduce duplicate master registrations and make friendship / rank progress commands easier to target correctly.
Cleaned up master identity handling so exact IDs like Janneftw2 (GodFormQuest) and Whis(Instructor) behave more consistently instead of creating extra duplicate cards.
Added SSJ4 fur color support with a separate configurable color path so SSJ4 fur can be tinted independently from normal HexHair color passes.
Expanded SSJ4 fur handling across both server-side sync/data behavior and mod-side rendering support, including animation-aware color behavior.

entries.title: HexMaster Current Master Fix
entries.summary: Master progression now correctly recognizes when the player is already training with the same exact mentor.
details: Added API-side current master checks so scripts can safely tell whether the selected master is the same mentor, a different mentor, or empty.
Fixed Janneftw2 (GodFormQuest) progression being blocked while the player was already training with Janneftw2 (GodFormQuest).
Current master comparisons now use canonical IDs instead of raw display names, preventing false mismatches from normalized IDs.
Exact mentor matching is preserved: Janneftw2 and Janneftw2 (GodFormQuest) are treated as separate masters.
Added script fallback checks so older API builds still avoid loose contains/indexOf matching.
Players should no longer need to deselect their current master just to continue rank-up or dialog progression with the same mentor.

entries.title: HexMaster Stability & Admin Tools Update
entries.summary: HexMaster received several backend, GUI, and script-side fixes focused on master portraits, NPC registration, friendship display, and admin cleanup tools.
details: Added an OP/admin delete tool inside the HexMaster GUI. Admins can hover a master card, click the red X, and confirm deletion without needing to type the exact internal master ID.
Expanded the delete tool so it appears on all visible master cards, including locked placeholders and globally registered entries.
Fixed HexMaster portrait caching issues where NPC icons could turn into question marks or require relogging after changing dimensions.
Improved portrait retention so player masters survive dimension changes more reliably, while NPC portraits can rebuild from saved snapshots or refreshed NPC interaction data.
Fixed an NPC lookup issue where a master NPC named like the player could accidentally render the player model instead of the NPC model.
Updated the God Form Quest master script so Janneftw2 (GodFormQuest) registers as an NPC master using the exact master ID, source name, and display name.
Adjusted the God Form Quest dialog unlock flow so it can detect the correct dialog path more reliably, including the Starting and Accept dialog steps.
Fixed quest friendship messages so they display the real stored friendship value after the quest reward is applied instead of trusting an API return value that could be wrong.
Cleaned up HexMaster chat formatting so gradient messages no longer break from unsupported spacing or scroll attributes in certain script contexts.
Added a Socket Opener config option so OP/admin bypass can require Creative mode, preventing OP players in Survival from accidentally bypassing normal socket limits.
Verified normal socket rules remain: accessories cap at 1 socket, armor/gear caps at 2 sockets, and weapons cap at 3 sockets unless admin bypass is active.
Fixed custom portal cleanup so breaking a frame or linked portal block can clear the connected portal instead of leaving floating portal blocks behind.
entries.actionSubtitle: Install the latest HexMaster/source patch and replace the updated GodFormQuest and quest friendship scripts.

entries.title: <wave><grad #54F7FF #FFFFFF #B66DFF>Master Idle Rewards Added</grad></wave>
entries.summary: Selected masters can now gain passive friendship over time.

entries.title: Server Script Tab Optimization
entries.summary: Player scripts were reorganized to reduce tab clutter, avoid duplicate event handlers, and keep related systems grouped together.
details: Merged Daily/Weekly and EcoBridge into one unified economy and progression script.
Added a known-command registry so valid commands from other tabs no longer trigger Daily/Weekly unknown-action warnings.
Combined AFK, Wands, and Dragon Ball wish handling into one shared script for easier maintenance.
Moved form-vanity handling into the newer Tab 2 vanity sync system to prevent duplicate vanity/desync issues.
Unified HexSkills, Dragon Fist, Grapple skill commands, and Black Coffin skill commands into one skill-management script.
Updated Dragon Fist to use N-based combos while keeping Black Coffin on its synced mod keybind.
Added safe dispatcher routing for shared hooks like chat, timer, tick, attack, keyPressed, and GUI events.
The cleanup should make the server player scripts easier to manage while preserving existing functionality.
entries.actionSubtitle: Test merged tabs first, then remove old duplicate standalone tabs after confirming behavior.

entries.title: HexHair and DBCHairPlus Hair Fixes
entries.summary: HexHair and DBCHairPlus were updated so built-in DBC hair styles work with custom coloring, split colors, gradients, and animation support.
details: Added support for DBC built-in hair styles 1-12 instead of only supporting the custom/V2 hair render path.
Preserved the bald built-in hair slot so it should not be force-colored or treated as visible hair.
Applied the same built-in hair compatibility fix to DBCHairPlus so both hair systems stay aligned.
Built-in DBC hairs now support HexHair color behavior, including split colors, gradients, and animation support where applicable.
Protected Ultra Instinct and Mastered Ultra Instinct behavior so those forms should no longer be incorrectly repainted black or override their intended white hair behavior.
Kept the hair pass focused on actual hair render calls while avoiding face, eyes, mouth, tail, and other non-hair parts.

entries.title: Skills Balance and API Cleanup
entries.bannerTitle: Black Coffin and Dragon Fist tuning update
entries.summary: Recent skill work focused on Black Coffin PvP balance, Dragon Fist server stability, cleaner config pages, NBT unlock checks, and API documentation for scripting.
entries.actionSubtitle: PvP tuning is now mostly config-driven
details: Black Coffin damage tuning was moved further into server config so future PvP and PvE balance changes can be adjusted without rebuilding the mod.
Black Coffin now supports defense-aware PvP Body chip scaling, allowing target DBC Defense to reduce the guaranteed Body chip instead of ignoring defense entirely.
Black Coffin level checks were tightened: level 0 blocks charging and casting, level 1 allows normal only, level 2 allows chant, and level 3 unlocks the third-form modifier.
Black Coffin and Dragon Fist config options were reorganized under the unified Skills section, with shorter keys for cleaner config GUI display.
Legacy and duplicate config entries were cleaned up, including old Black Coffin, Dragon Fist, and build-height test options.
Dragon Fist server optimization was added to reduce lag from active Dragon Fist entities, including active-entity cleanup, tick throttling, and max lifetime safety checks.
Dragon Fist PvP damage was nerfed through config multipliers while keeping PvE damage mostly unchanged.
Custom PvP death messages were added for Dragon Fist and Black Coffin so player deaths no longer appear as unrelated mob kills.
Black Coffin PvP balance is now controlled mainly through bcPvpN, bcPvpC, bcPvpT, bcChipN, bcChipC, bcChipT, bcChipDefScale, and bcChipDefFloor.
Dragon Fist PvP balance is now controlled mainly through dfPvpN, dfPvpR, dfPvpL, dfPvpB, and dfPvpAll.
New API reference documents were prepared for HexMasterAPI, HexDragonFistAPI, and the broader HexColorText API index to make scripting support easier to maintain.
Memory cleanup and server diagnostic scripts were tested to help track script-side lag, item/entity buildup, and server memory usage during development.

entries.title: Version 1.5.8 Ready for CurseForge
entries.summary: Version 1.5.8 is ready to be uploaded to CurseForge, with major Master system polish, cached portraits, API additions, combat balance tweaks, and new scripting support.
details: Hex Master and Friendship system received its final polish pass for this update.
Master GUI now supports colorful friendship and completion bars, rank-colored lesson stars, TEST badges, COMPLETE stamps, and cleaner overall completion display.
Cached master portraits now stay rendered after walking away from loaded NPCs, using remembered/cached render data instead of falling back to initials during normal gameplay.
Portrait debug badges for live, remembered, dummy, and initials render states can now be hidden or shown through config.
Master API received new completion helpers for reading overall completion, completion bars, unlocked master counts, completed master counts, mastered master counts, and master ID lists.
New script support was prepared for master setup, master requirement tracking, quest/TP rank-up checks, overall completion milestone rewards, and transform blocking during special tests.
Rank-up requirements were tested with both quest checks and TP costs.
Black Coffin now has player-target damage multipliers so PvP damage can be tuned separately from NPC and mob damage.
Dragon Fist Ki costs were reduced to make the skill easier to use: Normal 12%, Rush 18%, Loop 22%, and Blast 19%.
Version 1.5.8 is now considered ready for a final build, PvP damage test, backup, and CurseForge upload.

entries.title: Masters and Dragon Fist Update
details: Added a script-supported Master's system with selectable NPC and player mentors.
Masters now use a Xenoverse-style progression loop where friendship fills per rank, then resets after a successful rank-up test.
Overall completion is tracked separately from friendship, allowing progress to continue across all four master ranks.
Added support for quest-based and TP-based rank-up tests, including fresh quest completion checks so old completed quests cannot instantly pass tests.
Updated the Master GUI with mini progress bars, gradient friendship/completion bars, TEST READY styling, colored rank stars, and player master previews.
Improved /hexmaster command permissions so players can use basic menu/status commands while admin-only subcommands remain OP-gated.
Improved command tab completion for existing master names and online player master setup.
Updated Dragon Fist script support with backup Ki checking and draining so Dragon Fist variants properly consume Ki when the mod-side drain path misses.

entries.title: <#ffbcb1>Dragon Fist & Grapple Skill Pass</#>
details: Dragon Fist now has script-activated key combos instead of a built-in mod keybind: K activates Dragon Fist, Shift + K activates Dragon Fist Rush, Ctrl + K activates Dragon Fist Loop, and Alt + K activates Dragon Fist Blast.
Dragon Fist skill checks now use PlayerPersisted.HexSkills instead of the older HitSkills example path. Each variant can be unlocked separately through NBT checks.

Dragon Fist API cooldown handling was moved mod-side so scripts cannot bypass cooldowns, Ki costs, or skill gates. Cooldowns are now enforced through the API and controller path instead of relying on player scripts.

Dragon Fist cooldowns were corrected to be per-variant instead of shared globally. Normal, Rush, Loop, and Blast now each use their own cooldown while still preventing multiple armed Rush/Loop/Blast windows from overwriting each other.
Dragon Fist now consumes heavy DBC Ki when used, making it behave more like an ultimate skill. The API path handles Ki consumption for player casts while NPC/script scaling remains flexible.
Normal Dragon Fist was reworked into a forward barrage/pass-through style attack. It now uses a narrow line hitbox so lined-up targets can be hit without turning the move into a large radial AOE.
Normal Dragon Fist carry and knockback were retuned so targets are dragged only slightly during the barrage instead of being launched too far across the map.
Rush Dragon Fist was adjusted to finish with an uppercut-style hit that launches the target upward without sending them too high.
Dragon Fist Rush and Blast now respect the enableDragonFistCommandDragonForm config option, so script activation no longer forces the player into dragon POV when the config is disabled.

Dragon Fist damage was moved back to mod-side balancing instead of script-side scaling. Base stat damage, method multipliers, and barrage hit multipliers were buffed so the skill feels stronger for high-melee builds.

The Dragon Fist player script was cleaned up with better hyperstyle-style messages, cooldown time display, per-variant titles, and invalid combo protection for mixed modifier inputs like Shift + Ctrl + K.

Grapple skill handling was also updated with HexSkills-based NBT checks, and its locked warning behavior was changed so the message is not repeatedly spammed every time a grapple keybind is pressed during the same login.

entries.title: <grad #FF7A00 #FFD36B #FFFFFF #FFD36B #FF7A00 scroll=0.18 styles=l>Dragon Fist Skill Expansion</grad>
entries.summary: Dragon Fist received scripting support, active-window skill behavior, stronger cinematic variants, and early DBC ki blast visual support.
details: Added script bridge support so CustomNPCs scripts can trigger Dragon Fist, Grapple, Black Coffin, and several orb-style effects without relying on command execution.
Dragon Fist can now be called from scripts with custom caster, target, method, base damage, and strength multiplier parameters.
Normal Dragon Fist is stable as the direct strike version and remains the clean fallback/debug style.
Rush Dragon Fist now uses an active melee window. The caster gains a visible ready effect and a small HUD indicator, then the next melee hit triggers the skill.
Rush now performs an opening strike, launches the target into a short arc, carries forward through the target, deals a barrage of hits, then vanishes.

Loop Dragon Fist now uses the same active-window style and was rebuilt into a GT-style cinematic variant: the dragon soars upward, loops through the air, dives back down, and only then begins the main damage barrage.
Loop damage and DBC Body handling were improved so scripted and NPC versions should hit DBC entities more reliably.
Dragon rendering was tuned with denser path history and more body segments for cinematic variants so the dragon appears more connected during large movements.
Blast Dragon Fist now uses an active melee trigger. The caster lunges through the target with the dragon visual, turns back, then fires a DBC/JRMCore ki blast visual.
Blast uses the DBC/JRMCore ki blast as a visual projectile shell while HexColorText keeps control of the real Dragon Fist damage through its own damage bridge.
Dragon Fist command testing remains available for normal, rush, loop, and blast while the future real skill version can later scale from Strength, Melee, skill level, and cooldown settings.
Optimization note: cinematic dragon rendering still scales by distance to help reduce unnecessary FPS cost during larger Dragon Fist visuals.
entries.actionSubtitle: Normal, Rush, Loop, and Blast variants were expanded.

entries.title: Dragon Fist testing expanded
details: Added the first Dragon Fist command test framework, including normal, rush, loop, and blast variants.
Added a Dragon Fist cooldown shelf HUD with a mini dragon icon, using the same style as the Black Coffin cooldown display.
Dragon Fist command cooldowns now support separate cooldown timers per method, so one variant should no longer lock out every other variant.
Improved Dragon Fist command autocomplete for the available variants and aliases.
Improved the Loop Dragon Fist variant with a longer cinematic loop, stronger return dive, and more burst hits when it reconnects with the target.
Fixed the Hex Hair custom-form color leak check so normal SSJ hair can turn yellow again while addon/custom forms can still use custom hair color when enabled.
Quieted extra JRM GUI debug output now that the action menu transparency debugging is no longer needed.
Added groundwork for future Dragon Fist activation through NBT skill gates, keybinds, scripting methods, and cooldown tuning. The /dragonfist command will remain as a fallback/debug command.

entries.title: Rarity Detection & EvolveReady Fixes
details: Fixed new-item EvolveReady tagging so it now uses the intended 18% chance instead of accidentally applying at a guaranteed 100% rate.
Restored auto EvolveReady eligibility to Common+ rarity items while still blocking unknown or non-rarity items from being tagged.
Improved Effervescent+ detection so it is less likely to be mistaken for regular Effervescent during rarity checks.
Fixed a JavaScript regex boundary issue that could make fallback rarity detection fail inconsistently.
Updated mod-side rarity detection so glints and overlays can read hidden rarity markers stored inside LorePages, not only visible lore.
Tightened Black rarity detection to reduce false Black glints from text such as Pseudo Black, Blackflame, or other flavor lines containing the word black.
entries.actionSubtitle: EvolveReady, Effervescent+, LorePages, and Black glint detection were cleaned up.

entries.title: HexColorText Progress Update
details: Fixed the rarity overlay bug so items without real visible rarity lore no longer incorrectly show rarity frames/overlays in the slot UI.
Added orb achievements and expanded the achievement path for orb progression and collection tracking.
HexTail production is halted for now aside from keeping the current solid tail color support; broader tail work is being put on hold until later.
Grapple work is still in active testing/debugging and DBC-specific grapple damage can be added in a later pass.

entries.title: Sort Button and Unsocketer UI Adjustments
details: The inventory Sort button was repositioned again for better placement on the player inventory and creative inventory screens.
Chest and container Sort button placement was left alone since those screens were already in a good spot.
The Hex Unsocketer GUI received another text alignment pass to better match the new template-based texture layout.
Open, Filled, and Max text were nudged for cleaner spacing, and the Inventory label was shifted slightly lower for readability.
This pass was focused on visual cleanup only, with no changes to unsocketing logic or sorting behavior.
entries.actionSubtitle: Small placement and text-spacing tweaks for inventory sorting and the Hex Unsocketer.

entries.title: <grad #F06A2A #FFB36B #F06A2A scroll=0.18 styles=l>Reroll / Rarity Cleanup</grad>
entries.summary: Cleaned up reroll rarity detection and older item presentation issues.
details: Adjusted reroll checks so items are less likely to fail when their rarity marker is not shown cleanly on the default visible lore.
Improved support for items whose rarity data or marker presentation lives on lore pages instead of only the first visible page.
This helps fix cases where evolved or older items could incorrectly say they had no valid rarity to reroll.
Continued cleanup around legacy rarity presentation issues where an old visible rarity line could still appear alongside a newer evolved rarity presentation.
Older items with messy visible rarity lines can still be refreshed with !rarity migrate if needed.

entries.title: Hex Utility and Optimization Pass
details: Inventory sorting was added with a smaller custom-shaped Sort button. It appears in player inventory, creative inventory, and many chest-style containers.
The sorter can merge compatible stacks while preserving NBT, rolled stats, socket data, and other custom item data.
Rarity overlays and held/equipped glints were optimized with a shared render cache to reduce repeated lore and NBT parsing.
Custom hair rendering received an FPS-focused cache and render-policy pass. Custom-form hair color support was also added as a configurable option.
The heavier custom-form overlay and renderer leak paths remain disabled by default for safety.
Black Coffin charging was tightened so locked users should no longer see the charge HUD or GUI when the skill is unavailable.
Socketing gained unsocket support. Players can remove a specific socketed gem or remove all socketed gems while preserving returned gem stats, effects, and NBT.
A dedicated Unsocketer GUI was added alongside the existing command and script API support.
entries.actionSubtitle: Use the new Sort button in inventory or chest screens. Shift-click support is included.

entries.title: <grad #FFD24A #FFF2A6 #FFB300 #FFD24A scroll=0.18 styles=l>Levelup Balance Update</grad>
details: Updated the levelup system for endgame rarity progression.
• Effervescent+ now supports the older Effervescent_ naming as the same rarity.
• Black can now be reached from Effervescent+, but the chance is intentionally extremely low.
• Black still has a pity fallback after many failed levelup attempts, so progress is never completely wasted.
• Random non-rarity items in the third levelup slot are now ignored instead of failing the levelup attempt.
• The third slot only contributes when it is a valid matching-type donor.
• Effervescent+ tier growth was adjusted: 2 levelup attempts count as 1 effective tier.
• Effervescent+ now gets small stat growth per levelup attempt, with a stronger bonus when a full tier step is completed.
• Other rarities keep their original levelup behavior.

entries.title: <grad #C38CFF #8DB7FF #C38CFF scroll=0.18 styles=l>Combine System Update</grad>
details: Adjusted combine behavior for <grad #FFFFFF #E8E8E8 #D0D0D0 #E8E8E8 #FFFFFF scroll=0.14>Pseudo Black</grad> and <grad #000000 #0A0A0A #141414 #0A0A0A #000000 scroll=0.14 styles=l>Black</grad> items.

• <grad #FFFFFF #E8E8E8 #D0D0D0 #E8E8E8 #FFFFFF scroll=0.14>Pseudo Black</grad> can now wildcard-combine with any rarity once, then continues using its normal combine cap with matching rarities only.•
<grad #000000 #0A0A0A #141414 #0A0A0A #000000 scroll=0.14 styles=l>Black</grad> can wildcard-combine with any rarity up to 2 times overall
then continues with <grad #000000 #0A0A0A #141414 #0A0A0A #000000 scroll=0.14 styles=l>Black</grad>-only combines while still respecting the normal cap.
• Combine now keeps the main rarity overlay properly instead of donor rarity lines leaking onto the result.
• Chaos tiers now keep only the highest rank present during combine instead of stacking multiple chaos lines.

• Accessory type lines are now deduped, and when accessory types differ the result keeps the best base type in this order: <grad #FFD7F7 #FFB6E8 #FFD7F7 scroll=0.16>Amulet</grad> > <grad #7FDBFF #A8ECFF #7FDBFF scroll=0.16>Ring</grad> > <grad #FFD24A #FFF2A6 #FFD24A scroll=0.16>Artifact</grad>.

entries.summary: Added more hair customization work and continued Black Coffin ability tuning, including GUI fixes, preview cleanup, and casting speed polish.
details: Continued work on the hair customization system, including GUI cleanup and picker fixes so color selection behaves more reliably without accidental extra button clicks.
More polish was added around hair preview behavior, split-color testing, and general customization flow for DBC-style hair editing.

Black Coffin received more tuning for its casting flow, with focus on making the build-up and coffin formation feel slightly faster and smoother without changing the overall feel of the move too drastically.
This update continues the ongoing push to improve both character customization and custom ability presentation as more edge cases are tested.

Worked on combo support for newer style stacks including wave, rainbow, glitch, and rabbit / easter setups, along with continued testing for bold and nested style behavior.
Refreshed Hex Help examples and spring-style entries so newer wrappers and rabbit / easter examples are easier to test directly in chat.
More renderer polish and combo tuning is still ongoing as edge cases are found.
